header.label: About Us
header.title: {{name}} — Where Destinies Are Restored and Rearranged
header.subtitle: We are a community of believers committed to knowing Christ, growing together, serving others, and sharing the hope of the Gospel.

who.p1: Bethel Baptist is a Christ-centered church community committed to helping people discover the love of God and grow in their relationship with Jesus Christ.
who.p2: Our church is a place where people from different backgrounds can come together to worship, pray, learn from God's Word, build meaningful relationships, and serve others.
who.p3: Whether you are new to faith, returning to church, or looking for a church family where you can grow, we welcome you.

worship.title: Worship
worship.desc: We gather together to worship God through praise, prayer, fellowship, and the teaching of His Word.

prayer.title: Prayer
prayer.desc: We believe in the power of prayer and encourage one another to seek God in every season of life.

discipleship.title: Discipleship
discipleship.desc: We help believers grow deeper in their relationship with Christ and develop a life rooted in faith.

faith.title: Faith
faith.desc: We trust God, believe His Word, and seek to follow His purpose for our lives.

love.title: Love
love.desc: We strive to love God and love people with compassion, grace, kindness, and humility.

service.title: Service
service.desc: We use our gifts and resources to serve God, His church, and our community.

unity.title: Unity
unity.desc: We believe the church is one family, growing together and supporting one another in Christ.

vision.desc: At Bethel Baptist, we desire to see lives transformed by the Gospel, families strengthened through faith, and our community impacted by the love of Christ.

cta.title: Come Worship With {{name}}
cta.desc: We would love to welcome you and your family. Come as you are, meet our church family, and grow together in faith.

header.label: Get In Touch
header.title: We Would Love To Hear From You
header.subtitle: Have a question, need prayer, or planning to visit? Get in touch with us. We would be happy to connect with you.

heading.title: We Are Here For You
heading.intro: Whether you are looking for a church family, need someone to pray with you, or simply have a question, please reach out.
